ios.desc:
Discover Your Personal AI Running Coach with RunWatch

RunWatch brings coaching, training plans, and performance data together in one app. Your AI coach looks beyond single workouts and considers your recent training, current load, recovery, goals, and the sessions that are actually on your plan. The result is coaching that feels personal, credible, and practical instead of like a generic workout generator.

New in version 3.0: Coach Mode. Your AI coach now understands your training context better and responds dynamically to your training history, current condition, and plan.

Why Choose RunWatch?

• Coaching With Context:

Your AI coach checks your training plan, recent workouts, and relevant fitness data before making recommendations. That means answers that fit your actual day.

• Personalized Training Plans:

Get training plans and plan adjustments that reflect your goals, progress, load, and real-life schedule.

• Practical Day-to-Day Guidance:

Whether you need a morning check-in, help with your next run, or an adjustment after fatigue, limited time, or a missed session, RunWatch gives you clear next steps you can actually use.

• Seamless Apple Watch Integration:

Create workouts on your iPhone and send them straight to your Apple Watch. Start your training directly from your wrist.

• In-Depth Performance Insights:

The AI evaluates your fitness data and provides valuable insights, including:
	•	Weight trends
	•	VO2max analysis
	•	Resting heart rate tracking
	•	Heart rate variability (HRV)
	•	Running power output
	•	Running speed
	•	Ground contact time
	•	Stride length optimization
	•	Vertical oscillation efficiency

Avoid overtraining and optimize recovery with data-driven guidance, including Training Stress Balance (TSB) insights.

This app uses artificial intelligence from OpenAI to analyze your data and deliver context-aware coaching.
